facts.statement: The FAA's retrospective update identifies a January 5, 2024 door plug incident on Alaska Airlines Flight 1282.
On January 6, 2024, the FAA ordered temporary grounding of certain Boeing 737-9 MAX airplanes operated by US airlines or in US territory.
The FAA emergency airworthiness directive required inspections before further flight and said approximately 171 aircraft worldwide would be affected.

cases.subject: FDA updated 2023-24 mRNA COVID-19 vaccine authorizations

facts.statement: On September 11, 2023, the FDA approved and authorized for emergency use updated 2023-2024 mRNA COVID-19 vaccines manufactured by ModernaTX and Pfizer.
The updated monovalent mRNA vaccines included a component corresponding to the Omicron XBB.1.5 variant.
The FDA said the prior bivalent Moderna and Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccines were no longer authorized for use in the United States after that action.
NASA announced that the Bennu asteroid sample return capsule landed on September 24, 2023, at Utah Test and Training Range.
NASA reported that the returned capsule was taken by helicopter to a temporary clean room on the Utah range.
NASA stated that the asteroid samples were collected by OSIRIS-REx in October 2020, before their September 2023 return.
